summary: Builder label-scope enforcement is incomplete. forest.yaml scope.label is the authoritative GitHub-only mode (scope.go Scope doc; polls.go powderSubjects returns no Powder when Label != ""), but scopeEnvironment exports only FOREST_SCOPE_LABEL and the new Builder prompt treats only labels other than forest:ready as GitHub-only. With scope.label: forest:ready and POWDER_AGENT set, the Builder Run still lists and can take Powder jobs, contradicting the configured label scope. Required: communicate a configured label scope as an explicit GitHub-only signal rather than inferring it from label != forest:ready, and have the Builder honor that signal. Evidence: runner.go:229-238, agents/builder/agent.md:23-25 vs polls.go:139-153 and scope.go:8-13.
